featured.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
featured.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie made the case this week that systems of record have never mattered more. In a world where AI agents do 100X more work on these platforms than people ever did, governance, reliability, security, access controls and business logic become more critical, not less, because agents will be querying the data, processing tasks, executing workflows and collaborating with both human and agent users. He called the OpenAI Hugging Face incident "just a small peek into what the future will look like with agen…
featured.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 这周把「记录系统（system of record）」的价值重新抬到了台面上：在 AI agent 会比人类多做 100 倍工作量的世界里，治理、可靠性、安全、访问控制和业务逻辑这些老派能力反而更关键，因为 agent 会不停查询这些系统里的数据、执行流程、和人及其他 agent 协作。他把 OpenAI 与 Hugging Face 的那次事故称为「未来的一小片预览」——一堆 agent 到处跑着想完成自己的目标。但他也划了条线：只有那些用对的产品体验、API 和商业模式去接住 agent 的记录系统才吃得到这波红利。另一条更值得企业侧留意的观察是关于 ZDR（零数据保留）：他认为 ZDR 才是 AI 增长的隐形功臣，因为它极大简化了企业处理子处理方数据的合规流程；大多数企业的内部治理规定只允许使用 ZDR 模型，因为它们没办法把 PII 和敏感数据从 context window 里精确剥离出来。「没有 ZDR，AI 的扩散会直接停摆。」

featured.title: Madhu Guru · Meta AI 资深总监，前 Google Gemini/Veo/Nano Banana 负责人
featured.summaryEn: Meta AI Senior Director Madhu Guru, who previously led Gemini, Veo and Nano Banana at Google, published part 8 of his evals series on discriminatory power. His example: five systems score 94/93/95/94/92, but you already know A and C are substantially better than D and E. The eval is bad because it fails to surface that. "It's like giving a fifth-grade math test to a group of PhDs, everyone aces it and you've learned nothing about who is the smartest." The counterweight matters too: making evals arbitrarily hard ju…
featured.insightZh: Meta AI 资深总监、前 Google Gemini / Veo / Nano Banana 负责人 Madhu Guru 的 eval 系列写到第 8 篇，这次谈的是评测集的「区分度」。他举了个很直观的例子：五个系统跑出 94/93/95/94/92，但你已经知道其中 A 和 C 明显强于 D 和 E——那这个 eval 就是坏的，因为它没能告诉你这件事。「就像给一群博士出五年级的数学题，人人满分，你对谁最聪明一无所知。」但他同时提醒不要走向另一个极端把 eval 做得无限难，那样所有人都挂科，你测的也不再是系统本该做的事。他给的甜蜜点是三个词：真实 + 有难度 + 对能力差异敏感。最后留了个开放问题：当模型和 harness 变强、你的好 eval 迟早会饱和，那时候怎么办？

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex 与 ChatGPT 负责人
items.summaryEn: OpenAI's Codex and ChatGPT lead Thibault Sottiaux announced that the 5 hour limit is coming back for Plus accounts across ChatGPT Work and Codex, something he had flagged earlier and then postponed. His reasoning is twofold: the 5 hour window smooths compute load, which is what lets the plan stay generous on weekly usage, and Plus users are relatively casual and new, so they "accidentally eat through their whole weeks usage and then are confused." Pro $100 and $200 subscriptions will keep the limit disabled for th…
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex 与 ChatGPT 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 预告，5 小时用量窗口将在 ChatGPT Work 和 Codex 上对 Plus 账户恢复——这事他之前提过一次然后推迟了。他给的理由有两层：一是 5 小时窗口能把算力负载摊平，从而让周度总用量保持宽松；二是 Plus 用户大多是偏休闲的新用户，容易一不小心把整周额度一次性烧光，然后一头雾水，体验很差。他明确说明 Pro 100 美元和 200 美元档在接下来几个月不会启用这个限制。另外他还放了句狠话：2026 年的 DevDay 会是 OpenAI 历史上最好的一届，「而且不会接近」。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch went spelunking into why the `reset` command, the one everybody runs when their terminal gets into a bad state, is oddly slow. The culprit: 3BSD's `tset` in 1979 included a `sleep(1)` to let mechanical printer-and-ink terminals "settle down." That wait, written for hardware that no longer exists, still taxes every developer's terminal today. He had `fx` write a Zig replacement that runs in 1ms instead of 1s, and came away struck by how far back the stack goes and how enduring good system…
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 分享了一个很有画面感的考古发现：终端花屏时大家习惯敲的 `reset` 命令，慢得莫名其妙。他挖到根因——1979 年 3BSD 的 `tset` 里塞了一句 `sleep(1)`，为的是让机械式打印终端「稳定下来」。这句为已经消失的硬件写的等待，四十多年后还在拖慢每一个开发者的终端。他让 `fx` 用 Zig 重写了一个替代品，耗时从 1 秒降到 1 毫秒。他的感慨是：技术栈的根扎得比想象中深得多，好的系统设计有惊人的生命力，偶尔碰到的「蜘蛛网」也很迷人。附注很扎心——一旦开始用 `fx`，你会发现到处都是这种慢。他这周还提到 Vercel 的新东西「更快、更便宜、能力更强，而且更小」，直指软件随演进必然变慢变臃肿变大这个宿命。

items.title: Nikunj Kothari · FPV Ventures 合伙人
items.summaryEn: FPV Ventures partner Nikunj Kothari pulled back the curtain on how unconventional deals actually get done in venture: every one that finally gets wired "dies a 100 times" first. What saves them is usually a single champion sticking their neck out and quietly steering the deal to completion. His advice to founders is to identify who that real champion is and arm them with whatever information helps them make the case internally, because fund dynamics are won inside the room, not in the pitch. He also flags an overl…
items.insightZh: FPV Ventures 合伙人 Nikunj Kothari 把风投内部的真实决策机制摊开讲了：每一笔非常规的、最终真的打款的交易，在过程中都「死过一百次」。能活下来通常只因为有一个人愿意把脖子伸出来当 champion，然后安静地把它推过终点线。他给创始人的建议很实操——搞清楚谁是你真正的 champion，然后把一切能帮他论证的信息喂给他，帮他去搞定基金内部的动力学。他还点出一个容易被创始人忽视的角色：associate 和无投票权的合伙人反而极其有用，因为他们的激励天然是帮你的，而这个过程本身就是一次很好的测试——看他们上了你的股权表之后会怎么跟你合作。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: Y Combinator President and CEO Garry Tan posted a five step loop worth pinning up: form a view, turn it into an artifact or experiment, put it in contact with reality, read the result without self deception, revise and run again. The hard step is the fourth one, and it is where most teams quietly fail at being experiment driven. He also planted a flag in the datacenter debate, arguing that datacenters create jobs and prosperity. On tooling, he says Conductor Cloud has made him significantly more productive and fre…
items.insightZh: Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO Garry Tan 这周留下了一段可以直接贴在墙上的五步法：形成观点 → 变成一个 artifact 或实验 → 让它与现实接触 → 不自欺地读取结果 → 修正后再跑一遍。整段话最难的其实是第四步——「不自欺地读结果」，这也是大多数团队在实验驱动这件事上失败的地方。他同时在数据中心的舆论战场上明确站队：数据中心实际上创造就业和繁荣。工具层面他提到 Conductor Cloud 让他生产力大增，而且不用再把 MacBook Pro 一直开着盖子。

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程与访谈创作者
items.summaryEn: AI tutorials creator Peter Yang flagged a product signal worth taking seriously: whenever he has to log in to a new website or app, or even use an agent that is trapped inside a website or app, he usually just stops using the product entirely, with entertainment and gaming as the only exception. For anyone building software, that reframes login walls and UI-bound agents from friction into churn. He is also crowdsourcing a build: using AI to place voice calls to customer support numbers, navigate the terrible autom…
items.insightZh: AI 教程创作者 Peter Yang 抛了一个产品侧的信号：只要一个网站或 app 逼他注册新账号，甚至只是把 agent 困在某个网页/应用里，他基本就直接放弃使用这个产品——唯一例外是娱乐和游戏。对做企业软件的人来说这是个值得警惕的转向：登录墙和「困在自家 UI 里的 agent」正在从摩擦变成流失原因。他另外在公开征集方案：想让 AI 用语音去打客服电话，穿过那些糟糕的自动语音菜单，找到真人，帮他预约或退订。他还顺手调侃自己已经有 3 个 AI chief of staff，下一步显然是再加一个。

items.title: Zara Zhang · 创业者、Follow Builders 作者
items.summaryEn: Builder and Follow Builders author Zara Zhang offered an unpopular opinion: hackathons are an outdated event format, at least the way they are traditionally held. The subtext is worth sitting with in an era where AI has made weekend-to-working-product routine, since the scarcity that made locking people in a room for 48 hours valuable has largely evaporated. She also praised David Senra's interviewing style for immediately cutting to the chase and getting guests to be their most natural selves, noting that after w…
items.insightZh: 创业者、Follow Builders 作者 Zara Zhang 放了个不太受欢迎的观点：hackathon 作为一种活动形式已经过时了——至少传统办法是这样。在 AI 让「一个周末做出可用产品」变成日常的当下，这个判断的潜台词值得琢磨：当从零到 demo 的成本趋近于零，把人关在一起熬 48 小时的稀缺性也就没了。她另外推荐了 David Senra 的访谈风格——上来直接切入正题、让嘉宾回到最自然的状态；她说自己看过大量 Sam Altman 的访谈，这一场是他最松弛的一次。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad shared a first-person product comparison: Replit Agent has completely replaced Claude CoWork in his day to day work. His reasons are specific rather than promotional, describing it as much more persistent and fastidious, and better at using code and software to actually complete tasks. That last point is the interesting one, since whether an agent treats work as conversation or turns it into executable software is becoming the dividing line for this generation of agent products.
items.insightZh: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 给出了一条来自 CEO 本人日常使用的产品对比：Replit Agent 已经在他的日常工作中完全取代了 Claude CoWork。他给的理由具体到了行为特征——更持久、更一丝不苟，而且更善于用代码/软件本身去完成任务。最后这点是重点：agent 是把任务当对话处理，还是把任务落成可执行的软件，正在成为这一代 agent 产品的分水岭。

items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: Every CEO Dan Shipper is publicly asking for help after Google disabled Every's YouTube account with zero notice and no reason given. For any team that distributes content on a platform, it is a blunt reminder that platform accounts are rented assets that can be pulled without an obvious appeals path. He is still looking for anyone with experience recovering one.
items.insightZh: Every 的 CEO Dan Shipper 公开求助：Google 在零通知、零理由的情况下停用了 Every 的 YouTube 账号。对任何把内容分发押在平台上的团队，这是一次很直接的提醒——平台账号本质上是租来的资产，随时可能在没有申诉通道的情况下被收回。目前他还在四处找能帮忙恢复的人。
